newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Flextronics a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Flextronics a buy.

text.p: -- Robertson Stephens & Co said its analyst Keith Dunne has started coverage of computer circuit board maker Flextronics Intl Ltd with a buy rating.
-- The company specializes in making low-cost boards for original equipment manufacturers in computer peripheral, medical, communication and consumer products.
-- Over the past three years, Flextronics has turned in positive earnings reports on a 64-percent average annual gain in sales. Dunne sees annual earnings growth of 25 percent.
-- He expects the company to earn $1.56 a share in 1997 and $2.00 a share in 1998.
